title: Amba Steels v. M.D. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pritinker Diwaker, J. and Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following Dev Prayag Paper Mill.
headnote: Writ challenging an additional-security demand and clause 4.20(1) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003 dismissed in terms of Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016, 21.3.2017).
facts: Amba Steels petitioned against Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. over a demand for additional security for electricity supply, with a warning that non-payment within the stipulated period would attract action in accordance with law. It also challenged clause (1) of para 4.20 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005—insofar as it lets the consumer opt only as and when the distribution licensee provides a choice—as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003. Counsel accepted that identical matters had already been dismissed.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the additional-security demand and clause (1) of para 4.20 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003 is dismissed in terms of the order dated 21.3.2017 in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 (M/S Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) v. State of U.P.).
